G'oya

Avval har bir mijozning birinchi buyurtma sanasini topamiz: customer_id bo'yicha MIN(order_date). Endi har bir mijozga bitta qator va bitta sana to'g'ri keladi. Keyin shu sanalarni oy bo'yicha guruhlab sanaymiz.

Yechim

SELECT SUBSTR(CAST(first_date AS TEXT), 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS new_customers
FROM (
  SELECT customer_id, MIN(order_date) AS first_date
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
) t
GROUP BY SUBSTR(CAST(first_date AS TEXT), 1, 7)

Oyni SUBSTR bilan olish ikkala bazada bir xil ishlaydi: sana matnga 2024-03-05 ko'rinishida aylanadi. Xohlasangiz, PostgreSQL'da TO_CHAR(first_date, 'YYYY-MM'), SQLite'da strftime('%Y-%m', first_date) yozing.

Namunada 1- va 2-mijoz yanvarda, 3-mijoz fevralda, 4- va 5-mijoz martda birinchi marta buyurtma bergan: 2, 1 va 2. Fevralda 1-mijoz ham buyurtma bergan, lekin u yangi emas.

Tuzoqlar

Har oyda nechta har xil mijoz buyurtma berganini sanash boshqa savol. Unda qaytgan mijozlar ham sanaladi va namunada fevral 2, mart 3 chiqadi:

Noto'g'riSELECT SUBSTR(CAST(order_date AS TEXT), 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS new_customers
FROM orders
GROUP BY SUBSTR(CAST(order_date AS TEXT), 1, 7)

Birinchi buyurtmani MIN(id) bilan qidirish ham xato. Buyurtma tizimga kechikib kiritilgan bo'lishi mumkin, eng kichik id eng erta sana degani emas. Birinchilik sana bo'yicha aniqlanadi.
